tasks.label: colcon build: so101_pick_place
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && cd ~/ros2_ws && colcon build --symlink-install --packages-select so101_pick_place && source install/setup.bash

tasks.label: launch: realsense (align_depth)
tasks.command: source ${workspaceFolder}/scripts/setup_env.sh && ros2 launch realsense2_camera rs_launch.py align_depth.enable:=true
